working: (1) is wrong: having two or more polypeptide subunits defines quaternary structure, not tertiary structure. (2) is wrong: many single-chain proteins with only a tertiary structure, such as myoglobin, are biologically active. (3) is correct: in a beta-pleated sheet, neighbouring peptide chains lie side by side and are held together by hydrogen bonds between chains, which the NCERT text calls intermolecular hydrogen bonds. (4) is wrong: the alpha-helix is a right-handed helix, not left-handed.
